title: Saw signals
description: Power, feed, position and vibration are captured during cutting.

title: Active cut
description: Setup, idle and return motion are excluded.

title: Risk features
description: Eight descriptive statistics summarize each physical signal.

title: Random Forest
description: A calibrated model turns the features into a risk score.

title: Risk check
description: A score at or above 0.25 marks the part for inspection.

title: Hold & inspect
description: Inspect before Milling instead of discovering the defect later.
